mapper.select: select INDEX_ID id, INDEX_NAME text from MST_INDEX_INFO

select FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LOWER*100 rateLower, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LIMIT*100 rateLimit, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_ID baseRuleId, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE effDate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_TYPE rateType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE*100 rate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.COEFFICIENT coefficient, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_ID indexId, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RESET_TYPE resetType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LOWER*100 rateLower, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LIMIT*100 rateLimit from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO, FIN_PRODUCT, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD where FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BRANCH = 0
AND ((FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE != #{dealMode10}) OR (FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode10} ))
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE = #{publishType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and (FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LOWER*100 rateLower, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LIMIT*100 rateLimit, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_ID baseRuleId, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE effDate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_TYPE rateType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE*100 rate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.COEFFICIENT coefficient, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_ID indexId, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RESET_TYPE resetType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LOWER*100 rateLower, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_LIMIT*100 rateLimit from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO, FIN_PRODUCT, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD where FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BRANCH = 0
AND ((FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE != #{dealMode10}) OR (FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode10} AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.TERM_TYPE != #{termType02}))
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE = #{publishType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE = (select max(EFF_DATE) from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T1 WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE = T1.BASE_RULE_TYPE AND T1.EFF_DATE >= to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= T1.EFF_DATE)
and (FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.delete: delete from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and BRANCH = 0
